issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 10 requests the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken, but the solution file returns the Radweg name instead of an identifier. This mismatch between the requested attribute (ID) and the returned attribute (name) can confuse students about what to select and evaluate, and it makes the solution inconsistent with the problem specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the SELECT in aufgabe10.sql to return the Radweg identifier column instead of the name. For example, replace SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name with SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_schluessel (or the actual radweg ID column name used in the schema). Ensure the rest of the query remains the same so it filters by Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberfranken' OR 'Unterfranken'.

issues.description: Problem statement asks for the IDs of Radwege (task 10) but the solution returns the Radweg name (SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name). This mismatch between the requested identifier (ID) and the attribute returned (name) creates confusion about which column students should select and how the Radweg entity is identified across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by selecting the Radweg ID column instead of the name. For example, change the solution to SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id (or Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.id depending on the schema) FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde ... OR update the problem statement to ask for Radweg names if names are intended.
